passage: A manufacturing test found that using recycled aluminum for the laptop frame cuts material emissions by 38 percent and does not affect durability. It increases unit cost by $4 and creates a slightly different finish. The hardware team recommends adopting it in the next model and showing customers the finish before launch.

keyPoints.text: The next laptop should use recycled aluminum.
It cuts material emissions 38% without reducing durability.
It adds $4 per unit and creates a different finish that customers should see before launch.

referenceAnswer: Use recycled aluminum in the next laptop: it cuts material emissions 38% without hurting durability, at $4 more per unit.
